image_description: A low-angle, wide-shot of a rock band performing on an outdoor or tented stage. Three musicians are visible: a vocalist on the left in a white hoodie, a bassist/guitarist in the center wearing a leather jacket and hat, and another guitarist on the right. The stage is cluttered with equipment including large wedge monitors, microphone stands, and music stands. Overhead, a metal truss system supports lighting fixtures and decorative bunting flags. The background shows the curved interior of a tent structure.
